paragraphs: Batittai led prayer and fell silent at Ofannim; they asked Rabbi Avin. The checked Jerusalem Berakhot 5:3 reads Rabbi Avon [Heilprin cites Ein Omedin, mishnah 4]. Tosafot, Berakhot 34a: asked Bon.
